subject.title: fix(control-ui): resolve Personal card avatar 401 via data URI

question: Should maintainers continue this narrow conflicting PR, or consolidate the Personal-card avatar 401 fix on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 after its current blocker is repaired?
rationale: Automation can identify the mechanical blockers, but choosing the canonical landing PR for several overlapping avatar fixes and deciding whether to ask this contributor to rebase is a maintainer routing choice.

options.title: Consolidate on the current-main owner-path PR
